review_basis: AI-assisted visual description of all 24 existing interior images and the cover; the relationship diagram and goal mind map were also inspected individually. Descriptions identify visible content, not verified recording identities, scientific evidence, or permission status. The static GIF and PNG twin have identical decoded pixels.

A person climbs a staircase toward a target at the top.
A speaker in a yellow suit stands with open arms beside the words “Why you should stop setting goals (yes, really)” and a TED logo.
A glowing brain is surrounded by faces expressing happiness, affection, sadness, anger and surprise.
Two hands support brain outlines labeled IQ and EQ, each viewed through a magnifying glass.

A person raises both arms as banknotes fall around them.

A speaker holds a presentation remote on a stage with part of a TED sign behind him.
A futuristic living room contains robots, a robotic vacuum and wall-sized digital displays; drones are visible through the windows.
Two back-to-back artificial faces contrast exposed circuitry with a smooth white robotic exterior.
A thumbnail reads “Things are going to get weird.” A small human figure stands beside a large stylized eye; a TED-Ed logo is visible.
A heart and a human head are connected by a tangled line, linking emotion and thought.

Master Speaking. Think clearly. Speak with purpose. An English speaking course in eight thematic units by Abdul Raziq Nazari, The TOEFL House. Read, listen, discuss, present. Communication, critical thinking, real-world discussion. Teal and gold flowing lines decorate the cover.
